title: You Don't Need Strong Assumptions: Visual Representation Learning via Temporal Differences
author: Ninad Daithankar; Alexi Gladstone; Yann LeCun; Heng Ji
summary: TDV is a new method that learns visual representations from videos without relying on strong assumptions or biases. It predicts how frame representations change over time using a learned motion encoder, achieving performance similar to top models. This approach supports scalable and flexible learning by focusing on natural temporal differences in video data.
